timeline.tweet: There are NEW baby #owls in my tree!!! 💚💚💚 Admittedly, my picture is crap, but I'm so excited and don't have a better one. Such beautiful, fluffy (and veeeery vocal!) birds! 💚 The second owl family in my neighbourhood within a few weeks! #wildlifeinmygarden #owlets
Good to hear you're ok! 😉 A few weeks ago I've spotted you in a German news show! It was about the Extinction Rebellion in London! 💪💪

Our Paul(chen)! 😻🐱 A rescue himself, he's been very poorly when he adopted us, but then he turned into this most gorgeous black cat, a lovely and kind soul.❤Sadly he died 3 years ago (after his lunch in his sleep, not the worst death I'd guess), but he's forever in our hearts.

You're right, it feels like that. I've been in a relationship with a man my age (43), he left me because he fell for a 20 year old girl. I can't even begin to describe how hurtful this is...competing with a girl the age of his oldest daughter. 😢😟

2/ If I saw that in a movie I'd say 'how unrealistic!', but this really happened to me. Comparing me to her he also stated 'I was not attractive enough'. That really did hurt me, and still does to this day to be honest.

I'm heartbroken, sadly our lovely Piep passed away today. 😥 He has been a loyal friend and family member for more than 10 years. We loved him dearly, and hope he'll smile down on us from cat heaven. 🐈❤🌈
Thank you so much for your great kindness, it means so much to me. ❤ Losing a loved one is so painful.

Oh, what a wonderful message, thank you so very very much! ❤😘 Reading it left me with teary eyes. Your comfort and condolences mean so much to me. Very often I feel that only pet people really understand other pet people and what the loss of a beloved family member means.
So sorry for your loss, it's so hard to lose a beloved furry friend. 😥

Thank you so much for your comfort, it means a lot to me! ❤ Although he died on Monday sometimes we still wait for him to come home. 😿 But I know he did have a wonderful cat life, and where he is now he is healthy and happy.

I feel your pain, Drew, and am so sorry for your loss. 😿 Losing a beloved pet is like losing a family member and loyal friend at the same time. Take your time to heal, but know that Maisie is smiling down on you from the heavens. ❤
I'm so angry that the FDP made the 5 % again, they're utterly useless.
Well, it seems one has to pay for his temporary house arrest! 😹😂😂😂
That's really comforting to know your dad died surrounded by his family. Still very sad though.
Seems we'll all being married off!! 😂😂😂 Goodbye spinsterhood! And then you can have as much good butter and pizza as your heart desires! 😋😋

You're so right, Lucy. Dogs know and feel, they are such wise and wonderful creatures. 🐶❤ Juno had an especially sad destiny, the lad who rescued her tragically died of a heartattack (he was 40!!), but thank goodness my friend Claudia adopted her. ❤
I might be able to adopt a cat from the shelter at the weekend! 😻 My heart is very happy about it! ❤

Hello all,I'm happy to introduce the latest addition to our family to you, Kasper!❤😻 We adopted him from our local shelter,he's 5 yrs old and really cute.Though we've had a bit of a bumpy start together,but with loads of love and patience we're getting there.❤😻#AdoptDontShop

This were the first news I've read this morning,just started the new year with tears.Imagine the panic of the poor animals,what a gruesome, horrible death.I honestly despair about mankind. By now they said it have been sky lanterns (not allowed in Germany) which caused the fire.

I'm so sorry for your loss! I'm sure your cat has been a lovely one, a family member and companion. 💚 What a lovely gesture from your vet!! It will mean so much to many people who've lost a beloved pet.

My Paulchen. ❤ He adopted us in 2010 and I loved him to bits. Sadly he's not with us anymore 😿, but he had a happy life and a merciful death, he munched his lunch, cuddled up for a nap and didn't wake up again.

Is it true I can ask someone special today to marry me, and if he's turning down my proposal he has to buy me something as a wee comfort? ❤😍☺ Please tell me all the details, I've never heard of this before and wouldn't want to miss that opportunity! ☺ #February29th #LeapDay

Oh no, Liza!😊 He died a natural death and is buried in the garden. When I was a child my parents used to slaughter the chickens and we ate them, but if my memory doesn't fail me maybe since 25 years our feathery friends just live a very happy life until they die of old age.🐥🐔

Such a beautiful boy!❤ We used to have a 'tame' one for many years (sadly he died last year), and he and his babies *loved* cat food once in a while! 😺 Maybe Spraoi would be willing to generously chip in with some of his treats too? 🐶 Might work with dog food as well! 😉

Hooray!! 👵❤👴 It's my parents' 58th wedding anniversary today! 💐🌹🌺 They are - and have always been - a perfect team, loving and supportive of each other, and of us, me and my brother. 💚 #weddinganniversary #forbetterorworse #hochzeitstag
Thank you so much, my dear Irina!! ❤ It's really special to have a marriage like my parents. I sincerely hope they'll have some time more together!

Dear all, fox cub update!! 💚❤ Sadly his mum was found dead.😥 BUT thank goodness the tiny one is in good hands, thriving and prospering. And he's a very good eater! Look! 😍 And listen! #fox #foxcub #wildlife #bottlefeeding #babyfox #Fuchs
Those movies always remind me how utterly grateful we all should be that we never had to experience a war. 😞
I can't 'like' this tweet, Irina, this reality of war is just so horrible and heartbreaking. What 'humans' did and do to others in the name of war is so gruesome and dehumanizing. 😞😞

I hate them with all my heart. And I honestly despair seeing this, ruining all the effort to keep the numbers down just because ppl think their basic rights are breached. During a pandemic. While they're only asked to stay home. People suck big time. 😟😟

😥Dear twitter friends, I'm very sad to tell you that my dear mum lost her battle with cancer 2 days ago. I'm heartbroken that she's gone, but it's also a relief that her suffering is over. My dad, brother and me have been with her, and she could die at home in peace. #fuckcancer

Thank you Diane for your great kindness. 😗 I can't believe it's already one week since my dear mum passed away. I just returned from the cemetery, it's at the end of our street so we can easily visit her.

Thank you so much Delphine. 😘 My mum's funeral took place two days ago and it was such a peaceful and beautiful event. Due to Corona everything took place outdoors, and there have loads of birds, even a squirrel!, around and the sun was shining.

My dear Noemi, thank you for your kind words, they mean so much to me. 😘 I just returned from the cemetery, it's not far from my parents' home so we can easily visit her grave. The funeral has been two days ago, but to tell you the truth, time or days don't mean anything to me.
Thank you so much for your great kindness, Séan! 😗 I can't believe mum died one week ago, I couldn't even tell how I've spent the past seven days, I just function.
Thank you so much for your great kindness. 😘 And you're totally right, we all are so grateful that she could die at home and we were all there for her.
Thank you so much, Dianne, for your great kindness! ❤😘 Two days ago it was mum's funeral. Due to Corona everything took place outdoors, and it was such a beautiful and peaceful 'event'.

Dear Eilín, thank you so much for your kind and comforting words. 😗 It's already one week since my mum passed away, time was honestly flying. Two days ago it was her funeral, and it was such a peaceful ceremony.

Thank you so much, dear Cloudy. 😘 I just returned from my mum's grave, her funeral took place on Tuesday. It was such a peaceful ceremony. At the moment I just function. We are all heartbroken, but I take special care of my dad. He and my mum have been a couple for 59 years.
Thank you so much for your kind words. 😘 I can't believe it's already one week since my dear mum passed away.
Thank you so much for your kind and comforting words. 😘 It's unbelievable for me that mum has passed away one week ago, time and days have no meaning for me at the moment.

Thank you so much for your great kindness and comforting words. 😘 My comfort is that her suffering came to an end, and that we could be with her. Her burial has been two days ago, it was a beautiful and peaceful ceremony.
Thank you so much, dear Ave. 😘 I still can't believe that my mum is gone. We are all very sad, but I'm most worried about my dad, they have been together for 59 years.

Thank you dearly for your comforting & kind words,they mean so much to me.😘I feel like I haven't really understood that my mum is gone forever. The funeral took place 2 days ago,it was a beautiful & peaceful ceremony. The cemetery is in our street, so we can regularly visit her.
Dear Dee, thank you so much for your great kindness. 😘 It's already one week since my mum passed away, I can't believe it. I just function.

Thank you so much dear Sasha.😘 You're totally right, we exchange a lot of memories about our mum to make the situation a bit more bearable. On Tuesday it was my mum's burial, it has been such a peaceful ceremony and the pastor found such beautiful words for my mum's last journey
Dear Catherine, thank you so much for your comforting words. 😘 On Tuesday it was my mum's funeral, it was such a peaceful ceremony on a beautiful day.
Thank you so much for your great kindness. 😘 I still can't believe my mum has passed away one week ago already. But she's at peace and free of pain now.
Dear Derek, thank you so much for your great kindness. 😘 One week ago my mum passed away, I still can't believe it, every day I just function.

Oh Martin, thank you so much for this message, what a lovely thing to say about me! 😘 My mum's burial has been two days ago, it was such a peaceful ceremony on a beautiful day. These days I only function, and I'm afraid my mind hasn't fully understood that she won't come back.

Thank you so much dear! 😘 Your kind words are a great comfort for me. It's still unbelievable for me that my mum has passed away one week ago and that she'll never return. But I'm so glad that she's at peace now and doesn't have to suffer anymore.

My dear Marina, thank you so much for your kind and comforting message. 😘 Seven days already since my mum has passed, it's still unbelievable for me. Two days ago it was her burial, a most peaceful ceremony on a beautiful day.

Thank you so much Jane, that's very kind of you. x We lost my mum to cancer exactly two weeks ago, I don't know how all the days have rushed by. Today we've chosen a beautiful gravestone for her. We miss her very much. 😥😟

Dear all, thank you so much for consolation & your expressions of sympathy on the death of my mum.❤ I'm overwhelmed by your great kindness. I dearly miss my mum, but she rests in peace now after all her suffering. Found this lovely pic of her today as a young woman. #fuckcancer

To be honest with you, it's all still so surreal for me...two weeks ago she has left us, and I still I expect her to be around. I have been so busy these past days with paperwork etc that I haven't had a chance to grieve. We miss her. 💔

Having a loved one die during this pandemic can really turn out into a nightmare. My dear mum died 2 weeks ago, and the first thing checked was, did she die of Covid. If yes, she wouldn't even have been cremated and buried at our graveyard, but a huge anonymous one in Hannover.😥

Dear Emmet, what a lovely memory of your dear mum. ❤ And that family picture is just wonderful, a moment of joy. I lost my mum three weeks ago to lung cancer, I still feel totally paralyzed and only function. Though we say death came as a release my heart weeps. 😥
Oh, I'm so sorry to hear that. 😢 It's so devastating to lose a beloved pet. But it's such a comforting thought that you gave that rescue a beautiful life! ❤🐈
Oh, I'm so sad to read this. Losing a beloved pet is heartbreaking. Sorry for your loss.
I'm in love. ❤
Well, she was 82 years old, wasn't she? A few days after we've lost my mum to cancer. So apparently when you reach 82 years of age you're not allowed to live any longer. 😢😞😫

Thank you for your kind message, Kieran. And of course you're right, it's hard to find comforting words, and I'm very sure most ppl mean no harm with their comments. But like in your dad's case, dying at 67 is way too young in my world. Have a lovely Sunday! 🙋🌞
What a beautiful thought, my dear Irina. ❤😘 I also firmly believe she's in heaven now, free from pain and sorrow. Can you believe that my mum died 8 weeks ago? Time honestly flies.
Hello Jonathan, I hope your day did treat you kind!💚 I'm in happy anticipation as tomorrow is the last day of school for this term and I will be on holidays! Hooray! 🎉🎉

Aww, thank you! xx We lost my mum in May, we miss her a lot, but the cemetery is close so we can visit her often. It's a really peaceful place. I'm sorry to read about your injury. Hope you're not in pain! Please take very good of yourself, will ya? x

I'm so sorry you have to go through this. It makes me so angry how little empathy companies show when ppl suffer grief. My mum died not long ago, and when I cancelled her in-house emergency system they told me I need to follow the regular notice of 3 months. 😱😱
I sadly never got to know my grandparents. All four of them died early. 💔
My Paul. 💜 He used to be a stray but adopted us in 2010. He lived with us for seven happy years, and then died in his sleep from one moment to the next. I still miss him. 💔❤
#BlackCatAppreciationDay My Paul. ❤ Sadly not with us anymore, he died in 2017 in his sleep. He used to be a stray when he decided to adopt us. I still miss him a lot, such a lovely boy. 💔❤😻

Ah thank you for asking!😘 I'm just having a short break on my couch. School started again, it's just horrible. All students back, no distancing, masks only on the premises but not in class.😱I'm honestly scared there will be loads of new Corona cases soon. It really feels wrong!

So I mixed something up, sorry! I thought that you'll be a Viking this weekend.😘 School is rather exhausting, but the interaction with (new) pupils is nice. Though today I had a new class, nearly all boys (16, 17 yrs old) and they were unbelievably bold. I sense challenges!😂
Nature is simply amazing! 💚 Hello my dear Irina, how are you and your mum? ❤ School started for me again last Thursday, and it's exhausting. I have to get used to it again!☺
I'm done with school and my psychotherapy for today, hooray! ☺ And I see you're busy with your quiz show again!😘

Dear all, today I cried at school... not because everything was horrible, but out of sheer joy & gratitude.❤ One of my former classes surprised me with the most beautiful collection of farewell & thank you presents. I'm so touched & happy & really emotional.💜😍 #teacher #school

Thank you for your concern, my dear Irina.❤😘 I'm honestly not surprised, I expected this to happen much earlier. I feel school is not really taking care of us, it's more like 'schools, jobs, the economy...everything has to get back to normal, the rest will fall into place.' 😱
I feel they're already dead.💔
Hello, and a very bright day to you! ❤😘 I can't believe it's Friday already, the last day of my holidays...back to school on Monday! 😖
Dear Tim, thank you so much. 💕😘 I still can't believe that my mum's gone for half a year soon. Hope you and Poppy are very well! 😻 I'm back working since yesterday. Oh well...
Thank you kindly for your comforting words, they mean so much to me. 💕 My mum died in May, and sometimes I feel I haven't even begun to understand what it will be for all of us without her.
Thank you so much, you're so kind. 😘💕 I've been so busy with so much stuff after my mum's death that I didn't even have the chance to grieve her. Those little things are particularly heartbreaking.
Thank you. Next Thursday it marks six months since my mum died.
Awww, sweet little baby! 💕💕💕 So sad it lost its mum, but I'm sure her animal keeper showers her with love and affection.😍
Wow, what a cutie! 😻😻 They are indeed very much alike. We used to have another of those boys for many years, sadly he died last year. This is him, Piep.💙

I'm so sorry, dear! 💔 It's heartbreaking to lose a beloved pet, they are like family members. But I'm sure Bob is smiling down on you from the heavens. ❤

Morning dear! 💚😘 What's new in your part of the world? Germany is in chaos mood,lockdown starts tomorrow and ppl are panic buying food, toilet paper etc again. At least the school authorities came to their senses,so from today on for this week we're homeschooling the students.
